text:
Alex: FYI I just opened a small PR that needs a quick review + changelog blurb before we cut tonight: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/8142 

Alex: It touches the autoscaler config and has one tiny behavior change (default cooldown from 30s -> 45s). Need backport to v1.22.

Charlie: @Alex linking the PR, thanks. Can you paste a 1-2 sentence changelog line here so I can add it to the release notes? :eyes:

Alex: Sure — suggested blurb: "increase autoscaler cooldown to 45s to reduce flapping under bursty traffic (user-facing: none)." Happy to tweak.

Nina: I can take the backport. Which branch is v1.22 cut from? Master or release/v1.22?

Alex: release/v1.22 — branch exists, small patch. Use `git cherry-pick -x <commit>` and push to `backport/v1.22/8142` then open PR against release/v1.22.

ReleaseBot: CI check started for PR #8142 — linux-build: queued, e2e-tests: queued. (status updates in thread)

Katy: Is this on the cut radar? We have a hard tag at 23:00 UTC. If CI is green and changelog is in, we should include. Otherwise we hold to the next patch.

Charlie: I can add the changelog entry after Alex's blurb. Alex — any objections to the wording above? Want to emphasize stability impact?

Alex: That's fine. Maybe append: "reduces transient autoscaler thrash during short spikes." Final: "increase autoscaler cooldown to 45s to reduce flapping during short traffic spikes; improves stability (user-facing: none)."

Charlie: Added to release notes draft. :white_check_mark:

Nina: Backport PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/8147 -> target `release/v1.22`. CCing reviewers. I'll wait for CI and then request merge.

ReleaseBot: CI for backport PR #8147 — linux-build passed, e2e-tests failed (flaky timeout). Retriggering.

Katy: If e2e is flaky, we can go ahead with a manual smoke if someone can run `make smoke` on the staging cluster. Who's available?

Nina: I can run the smoke in ~10m, will report results here.

Alex: thanks all — if smoke passes and CI stabilizes, please tag `v1.22.3-rc` after merge. If not, we'll move into the next cut.

Nina: Smoke passed on staging. No regression observed. :thumbsup:

ReleaseBot: e2e retrigger passed for #8147 — all green.

Charlie: Merging backport now. Will tag post-merge.

Katy: Great job, team. I'll mark this in the cut checklist as included.

Alex: Appreciate the quick turnaround.
